remarks: Welcome to Heights Crossing, Darien's premier luxury apartment community offering upscale living with unmatched convenience. Located directly across from the Metro North train station, Heights Crossing provides effortless access to New York City while nestled in a vibrant coastal town. This newly constructed 1-bedroom, 1-bath apartment blends refined design with modern functionality. The open-concept layout creates a seamless flow between the living, dining, and kitchen areas, maximizing natural light and offering flexibility in how you live and entertain. The eat-in kitchen is appointed with Quartz countertops, a bar-height island, GE appliances, custom cabinetry, and a designer tile backsplash. And, a stacked in-unit washer and dryer add everyday ease. The spacious bedroom features a spacious closet and an adjacent full bathroom with a sleek stall shower and premium fixtures. Designed for peace and privacy, the building offers enhanced soundproofing and high-performance exterior insulation. Residents enjoy a tranquil courtyard with a fountain, on-site retail, and close proximity to Noroton Heights shopping, the grocery store, pharmacy, and Darien's beaches and Great Island.
